model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the annual area (in thousands of hectares) dedicated to a specific agricultural or land use category across eight countries from 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled from 2013 to 2022 in sequential order. The vertical axis is labeled "Хиляди хектари" (thousands of hectares) and ranges from 0 to 1200, with major tick marks at intervals of 200, indicating a linear scale. For each year, there are eight grouped vertical bars, each corresponding to a country as indicated in the legend: Spain (blue), France (orange), China/continental (gray), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light blue), USA (green), and Argentina (dark blue). Spain consistently shows the highest values, with bars reaching approximately 980–1000 thousand hectares annually. France follows closely with values around 780–820 thousand hectares. China/continental and Italy are next, with values fluctuating between approximately 700–800 and 680–720 thousand hectares, respectively. Turkey’s values are around 400–500 thousand hectares, while the USA ranges from about 380–450 thousand hectares. Argentina consistently has the lowest values, with bars hovering around 200–220 thousand hectares. The bars for each country are grouped by year and appear to be sorted in descending order of magnitude from left to right within each group, matching the legend’s order. There are no visual annotations, shading, or highlighting to emphasize specific data points.
